messages:
Tess Howard: Heads-up: API reference shows /v1/generate using "prompt" (object) in examples but runtime now accepts a top-level "input" string or array. This mismatch is causing confusion in samples and SDK snippets. I opened a small PR to fix OpenAPI + examples: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4815
Diego Ramos: Thanks. Is this a breaking change or just docs alignment?
Tess Howard: Mostly docs. The server accepts both old "prompt" object (legacy) and new "input" field. We should document precedence: if input present -> use input; else fall back to prompt. Also update examples to prefer input.
Anya Feldman: Can you add preferred curl/python/js snippets? I'll update the site render. Also add a short migration note for customers that were using prompt.object shapes.
Diego Ramos: Suggested snippets below (feel free to edit):

# curl
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"Write a short summary of the following text...","max_tokens":120}'

# Python
resp = client.post('/v1/generate', json={"input": "Summarize this article.", "max_tokens": 100})
print(resp.json())

// JS
const res = await client.post('/v1/generate', { input: ['first part', 'second part'], max_tokens: 150 })
console.log(await res.json())

Tess Howard: Nice. Add callout in API reference: input can be string or array[string], nullable false. Update OpenAPI requestBody: input: { oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: array, items: {type: string}}] } and remove misleading prompt object example.
Anya Feldman: Also update the example response to include generation_metadata.model_version (we added that last sprint). I noticed some HTML examples still show the older response shape. Add a checklist in the PR description.
docs-bot: Automated check  PR 4815 created and passed linting: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4815 :white_check_mark:
Diego Ramos: Will push the OpenAPI patch and update JS/Python snippets. Can one of you run the preview build afterward?
Anya Feldman: I'll run the preview and scan for other endpoints that still use prompt.object. If we find any, we should group fixes to avoid multiple small PRs.
Tess Howard: Thanks all  added migration note: "If your client used prompt object shapes, migrate to input: string|array. For single-string legacy inputs, wrap as [str] when switching SDKs that require arrays." Will mark resolved after merge.
